seo.title: Maison Lumière — French pâtisserie and custom cakes
seo.description: Custom cakes, macarons, croissants and pastries from French recipes in Tashkent. 82% butter, Belgian chocolate, same-day delivery across the city.
seo.answer: Maison Lumière is a French pâtisserie at 18 Mirabad St., Tashkent. Custom cakes from 420,000 UZS per kilogram with 48 hours’ notice; macarons 18,000 UZS each, croissants 28,000 UZS. Open daily from 8:00, with delivery across Tashkent.

listing.description: A website for a pâtisserie, bakery, coffee shop or boutique. Warm paper and serif type, photos in arches, a menu in sections with prices and a counter ribbon — like a magazine about good food.

sections.title: Sweetness, made slowly
sections.subtitle: Cakes, pastries and viennoiserie from classic French recipes. Every morning, with 82% butter, Madagascan vanilla and Belgian chocolate.

sections.label: The house
sections.title: We don’t rush: croissant dough rests for three days, and tart cream cooks over a low flame.
sections.text:
Maison Lumière opened in 2021 on quiet Mirabad Street. Our head pastry chef trained in Paris and brought back the main rule: a dessert shouldn’t just be sweet — it needs character, texture and a finish.
We bake in small batches, so the counter empties by evening. Cakes are made to order only — for your occasion, your taste and your guest count. Seasonal berries come from farmers in Tashkent Region, nuts from suppliers in Samarkand.

items.title: Write to us
items.text: The date, guest count, occasion and flavour wishes — by phone or on Telegram.

items.title: We pick the filling
items.text: We suggest 2–3 combinations and a design sketch, and give you the exact price.

items.title: 50% deposit
items.text: It secures the date. Cakes are assembled no earlier than a day before the event.

items.title: Delivery or pickup
items.text: We deliver across Tashkent in a chilled box or have it ready when you arrive.

items.quote: We ordered a wedding cake for 80 guests — delicate, not cloying, and eaten down to the last crumb.
items.author: Madina

items.quote: The croissant here is like in Paris: flaky and smelling of butter. I stop by every morning on the way to the office.
items.author: Timur

items.quote: A macaron box for my mum’s birthday — beautifully packed, and all twelve were different.
items.author: Olga

items.q: How far ahead should I order a cake?
items.a: At least 48 hours. Wedding and tiered cakes need 7–10 days so there’s time for a tasting.

items.q: How much does a custom cake cost?
items.a: Classic cakes are 380,000 UZS per kilogram, signature mousse cakes 420,000 UZS, wedding cakes from 520,000 UZS. The minimum weight is 1.5 kg.
Yes, across Tashkent daily from 10:00 to 20:00. Cakes travel in chilled boxes; delivery within the city starts at 35,000 UZS.

items.q: Do you make sugar-free or gluten-free desserts?
items.a: Yes: macarons are naturally gluten-free, and we make sugar-free and gluten-free cakes to order — just mention it when you order.

items.q: Can I sit in with a coffee?
items.a: Yes, there are 24 seats inside and a summer terrace. Our coffee is brewed from beans roasted in Tashkent.
Yes: branded macaron boxes, coffee breaks and dessert tables from 30 guests. We’ll send a proposal within a day.
